files.firewall/cluster.fw:
[OPTIONS]
enable: 1
policy_in: DROP

[ALIASES]
admin_net 192.168.10.0/24 # admin workstations
vpn_users 172.16.0.0/16 # WireGuard VPN
backup_srv 10.20.0.5 # Proxmox Backup Server

[IPSET monitoring] # Prometheus + Zabbix
10.10.0.50
10.10.0.51

[IPSET dbservers]
10.10.0.21
10.10.0.22

[IPSET frontends]
10.10.0.11
10.10.0.12

[RULES]
IN SSH(ACCEPT) -source admin_net -log nolog # admin SSH
IN ACCEPT -source vpn_users -p tcp -dport 8006 # Proxmox web UI
IN ACCEPT -source +monitoring -p tcp -dport 9100 # node_exporter
IN ACCEPT -source backup_srv -p tcp -dport 8007
IN Ping(ACCEPT) -source admin_net
IN DROP -p tcp -dport 22 -log warning
|IN ACCEPT -p tcp -dport 3128 # legacy proxy

[group web] # web servers
IN HTTP(ACCEPT)
IN HTTPS(ACCEPT)
IN ACCEPT -source +monitoring -p tcp -dport 9100

[group db] # databases
IN PostgreSQL(ACCEPT) -source +frontends
IN ACCEPT -source +monitoring -p tcp -dport 9187
IN REJECT -p tcp -dport 3306
